hardware.variant: Luckfox Lyra Zero W, RK3506B, populated USB radio

inputs.name: EmberBSD evbarm GENERIC kernel ELF on FFS
EmberBSD multi-user FFS root
inputs.revision: earmv7hf with the BSD ifconfig wireless commands

inputs.name: EmberBSD evbarm GENERIC diagnostic uImage for the RAM test
inputs.revision: e485e7de2689b7c1226b4803c1934adabdd7f071 with a counted MM_GET_FW_VERSION query

inputs.name: EmberBSD ifconfig for the RAM test

scenario: Keep the previous kernel pair. Rename the staged ELF to /netbsd on FFS and the staged uImage to netbsd-GENERIC.ub on FAT. Remount FAT read-only and verify the installed and previous pairs by SHA-256. Run /sbin/shutdown -r now from the serial shell. Let U-Boot run /boot.scr from microSD. At the local root console, run ifconfig -l, ifconfig aicwf0 up, ifconfig aicwf0 list scan and ifconfig aicwf0. Test SSH public-key login from a host through a UART relay to the board loopback interface. Load the diagnostic kernel into RAM through UART0. Bring up aicwf0 and request two scans with the matching ifconfig. Repeat the test after a software reboot from a working Luckfox Linux station.
expected: The station appears in the interface list and comes up. A scan result for an access point would confirm radio reception.
observed: The shutdown service saved entropy. U-Boot ran /boot.scr and read the 11308316-byte kernel image from microSD. The kernel mounted dk1 as FFS and attached aicwf0 at uaicfw0. The system restored entropy before starting sshd. The interface list included aicwf0. Bringing it up succeeded. The scan exited with status 0 and printed zero rows. The interface reported status: no network. The host verified the SSH host key and completed public-key login through the UART relay. Before and after the reboot from Luckfox Linux, MM_GET_FW_VERSION returned the same 36 bytes. Each reply contained the ASCII string "zh Aug 08 2022 14:54:51 - gcf79227" and two trailing NUL bytes. In each RAM boot, both MM_ADD_IF confirmations returned status 1. All four attempts ended before the firmware scan request. Each ifconfig invocation returned exit status 1 and reported EIO. The interface reported no network in both boots.
limits: The PCB revision is unknown. The original microSD test used a software reboot. The diagnostic kernel ran before and after a software reboot from the working Linux station.

The earlier kernel and ifconfig returned zero rows without a scan error. The diagnostic driver requested station creation before the normal MAC initialization sequence. The matching build text and error status do not establish whether radio calibration or firmware state survived reboot.

The radio showed no association. Beacon reception and a DHCP lease remain unverified. The UART relay exercised the local SSH service. A separate SSH attempt from the host stopped during name resolution.
